name: WP-CLI command
description: Adds a WP-CLI command class with a PHPUnit test stub. Optionally uses the Singleton trait from rtcamp/wp-php-toolkit for shared-state commands.

inputs.description: PSR-4 namespace for the command class. Default 'Inc\Cli' matches the rtCamp skeleton; pass the project's actual sub-namespace (e.g. 'Acme\Blog\CLI') to override.
Directory for the command file. Default 'includes/Cli' matches the rtCamp skeleton; pass the project's actual sub-path (e.g. 'src/CLI') to override.
PSR-4 namespace for the test class. Default 'Inc\Tests\Cli' matches the rtCamp skeleton; override alongside 'namespace' for non-default projects.
Directory for the test file. Default 'tests/Cli'.
PascalCase class name, derived from name.

Use rtcamp/wp-php-toolkit Singleton trait for shared state. Pass 'true' or 'false'. Default 'false' (multi-instance) is appropriate for most CLI commands; choose 'true' when the command needs to share state across multiple invocations within a request.

wiring.description: Register the new CLI command. Insert immediately after the last existing WP_CLI::add_command() call inside the bootstrap method. Anchor is a hint when present; AI falls back to pattern sampling. Singleton commands call ::get_instance(); multi-instance use new.
